pain_points.label: Pain points

items.label: Time-consuming documentation
items.detail: Clinicians spend significant time on documentation, which AI note-taking aims to reduce by generating first drafts.

items.label: Difficulty focusing on patient care
items.detail: Excessive note-taking diverts clinicians' attention from delivering optimal patient care, a problem AI tools seek to solve.

items.label: Need for HIPAA-compliant solutions
items.detail: Clinicians require AI note-taking tools that are HIPAA-compliant to ensure patient data privacy and security.

items.label: Inaccurate or inconsistent notes
items.detail: AI note-taking aims to improve the accuracy and standardization of documentation by capturing real-time conversations and relevant context.

items.label: Microphone issues hindering AI notes
items.detail: Some clinicians experience AI note failures due to microphone problems, suggesting a need for robust hardware solutions.

items.label: Increased efficiency and productivity
items.detail: Clinicians desire tools that boost efficiency in documentation, allowing them to complete notes faster.

items.label: More time with patients
items.detail: A key outcome is reclaiming patient time by offloading the initial draft of notes to AI, fostering better connection.

items.label: HIPAA-compliant and secure tools
items.detail: Ensuring patient data privacy and compliance with regulations like HIPAA is a critical desired outcome for clinicians.

items.label: High-quality, accurate, and standardized notes

items.label: AI-generated notes in multiple formats

behavior_patterns.label: Behaviour patterns

items.label: Seeking alternatives and comparisons

items.label: Reliance on peer reviews and recommendations

items.label: Trialing free or low-cost options

items.label: Integrating AI into existing workflows

items.label: Integration with EHRs

key_opportunities.label: Key opportunities

bands.label: Directly supported
bands.meaning: Stated directly and repeatedly across multiple independent sources.

bands.label: Clearly indicated
bands.meaning: Stated clearly but in few sources, or implied consistently across many.

bands.label: Inferred
bands.meaning: Inferred from context; not directly stated in any single source.

score_scale.note: Three bands, not a continuous scale. The model cannot reliably distinguish a 72 from a 78, so it is not asked to.
